mainEntity.name: What has to be done before porcelain tile installation starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most porcelain tile projects should start with a subfloor check, layout planning, and moisture review before any tile is set. A contractor should measure carefully, confirm the floor is level enough, and decide whether a backer board or uncoupling membrane is needed before installation begins. Skipping that prep can lead to cracked tile, lippage, or hollow spots later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, the floor needs to be measured, checked for level, and prepared with the right underlayment or membrane. Good prep is what keeps porcelain from cracking or shifting later.
